title: Emrys and the Spire
author: Gideon Crane
blurb: Lena Halloran, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
